desktop.notesZh:
批次十（测试流图：质量监控执行流程图 + 会话测试结果页签）
① 工作流·质量监控在配置卡后新增「测试流图」卡：单元测试执行全流程 8 步节点图（gcc 编译 → ceedling 单元测试 → gcov 覆盖率插桩 → gcovr 报告生成 → 覆盖率检查(行覆盖≥80% shadow 门禁) → cpplint 风格检查 → cppcheck 静态分析 → clang-format 最终格式化），企业规范同款画布（192×48 节点 + SVG 箭头 + 必装/选装图例）；点击节点右侧明细列命令（mono）/做什么/规范要点/依据规范（可点开全屏文档）/磁盘产物；下方执行纪律带（check 链→lint 修完→最终 format、禁止中途格式化、入口指令）。数据源 quality-flow-catalog.ts 与 baf-quality 新增 TEST_FLOW_STEPS 权威清单做奇偶校验。② 环境卡工具链探测补第 7 项 clang-format（选装，手动安装提示）。③ 会话新增「测试流图」页签（工作流图之后）：同一 8 步链按真实工作区质量报告着色——.baf/reports/ut-coverage.json 驱动 check 链与覆盖率门禁（绿=通过/红=未通过/灰=未运行，行覆盖率% 与阈值、报告时间），static-analysis.json 驱动 cpplint/cppcheck（错误数），报告存在时可一键打开 HTML 覆盖率报告；无报告绝不编造结论，format 无独立报告显示纪律注记；新 @Remote testFlowStatus + 推送刷新 + 手动刷新。④ 显示开关：工作流通用新增「测试流图」开关（参考工作流图开关样式，默认开，旧快照兼容 !==false 读取）
desktop.notesEn:
Batch ten (test-flow chart: quality-tab execution flow + session test-results tab)
(1) Workflow > quality gains a Test-flow card after the configuration card: the full unit-test pipeline as an 8-step node chart (gcc build -> ceedling unit tests -> gcov instrumentation -> gcovr report -> coverage gate (line >=80%, shadow mode) -> cpplint style lint -> cppcheck static analysis -> final clang-format) on the enterprise-standards canvas (192x48 nodes + SVG arrows + required/optional legend); clicking a step lists its command (mono) / what it does / standard rules / governing docs (click for the fullscreen viewer) / on-disk artifacts; the discipline band below (check chain -> lint fixed -> final format, no mid-stream formatting, entry commands). The data source quality-flow-catalog.ts is parity-checked against baf-quality's new TEST_FLOW_STEPS list.
(2) The environment card probes a 7th toolchain member: clang-format (optional, manual-install hint).
(3) Sessions gain a Test-flow tab (after Workflow graph): the same 8-step chain colored by the workspace's REAL quality reports - .baf/reports/ut-coverage.json drives the check chain and the coverage gate (green=passed / red=failed / gray=not run, with line coverage vs threshold and report time), static-analysis.json drives cpplint/cppcheck (error count), and an existing HTML report opens in one click; missing reports never fabricate a verdict and format carries its discipline note; new testFlowStatus Remote + push refresh + manual refresh.
(4) Visibility switch: a Test-flow toggle joins Workflow > general (mirroring the workflow-graph switch, default on, legacy-snapshot-safe !==false read)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesEn: Projection, intake, transition, workflow tab Remote; full-go-path seven stages + drift/abandon/T11; Phase 6 bug fast path and T15 escalation; Phase 7 verify CheckRunner wires stack/guard adapters; §22.17 J: clickable path re-routing in the classify dialog (intake-mode-set) + five-field bug draft + auto-pop host row (state-driven auto popup) + gate dialog channel; OpenSpec×Matt fusion: the baf:standard-rules session section injects the standards source every turn; effectiveRouteKeywordRules passes tierMode through so dead-rule filtering follows the active grade mode
